name: APIVerveEmojiLookup
summary: Emoji Lookup searches emoji characters, tags, or categories to return descriptive names and classifications.
description:
Emoji Lookup searches emoji characters, tags, or categories to return descriptive names and classifications. Query by raw symbol, keyword tag, or category to inspect matching emoji glyphs, text descriptions, and categories.

This iOS/macOS SDK provides a convenient way to access the Emoji Lookup from APIVerve.
Supports both callback-based and async/await patterns.
